four_decisions.decision: Identification bounds and statistical/model uncertainty remain distinct typed artifacts, linked only by an exact admitted estimand/unit/scale. No identification width becomes statistical confidence or replaces missing uncertainty. Reuse ValueOuterSet/ValueEvidence and existing UncertaintyEnvelopeRef; A B31 stays separately owned.
four_decisions.rationale: Neither original B201 nor B202 requires a new identification carrier. Posterior draws are a statistical/model candidate law, not identification bounds or an institutional certification.
required_binding: source/model/fit/rule refs and applicable temporal roles supplied by producer context
four_decisions.absent_binding: Preserve unknown explicitly; no composition/authority eligibility is manufactured.

four_decisions.decision: For the new explicitly versioned posterior-summary profile, preserve weighted arithmetic mean separately from the legacy envelope point, name the envelope point median, and name its interval equal-tail inverse-CDF quantiles. Never widen that interval to include mean; never label median mean.

point_functionals.posterior_mean: sum(p_i*x_i), canonical admitted nonnegative finite float64 probabilities
point_functionals.legacy_envelope_point: weighted median = inf{x:F(x)>=0.5}, explicitly labelled median
point_functionals.nominal_E_consumer: resolved/recomputed named posterior_mean for this profile; historical unprofiled envelopes retain their existing generic point

four_decisions.interval_functional: equal_tail: inf{x:F(x)>=q}, q=(1-level)/2 and 1-(1-level)/2; stable sorting preserves tied atoms. Zero mass contributes neither mean nor quantile.
four_decisions.numeric_profile: Declare finite float64 representation; reuse existing common admission to normalize weights once, compare paired probabilities exactly, reject positive mass/CDF collapse. Existing DECIMAL_EXACT numeric policy preserves admitted carrier samples/weights without round-12 loss. This is no arbitrary-real or float32 backend precision promise.
four_decisions.authority: gate_eligible=false; exact draw retention does not certify chain mixing, effective sample size, likelihood regularity or causal/treatment/policy authority

four_decisions.decision: Reuse UncertaintyEnvelope wire 1.1 and its existing reader, numerical validator and inline PosteriorSamplesCarrier unchanged. The original B201 explicitly permits an explicitly labelled median compatibility projection with separate posterior_means. A strict versioned metadata profile supplies the named mean and interval semantics; historical artifacts do not acquire this profile or change interpretation.

v1_adequacy_evidence.existing_carrier: PosteriorSamplesCarrier already holds finite ordered samples, weights and sample_axis
v1_adequacy_evidence.existing_ref: UncertaintyEnvelopeRef plus existing persist/load_uncertainty_envelope stores the full metadata+carrier via configured CAS
v1_adequacy_evidence.new_requirement: Actual E readers currently use generic point; they must admit/recompute the explicit profile before selecting named mean.

four_decisions.no_envelope_v2_reason: This chosen representation keeps a valid contained generic point and stores a separately named mean, exactly the compatible route in the original card. Changing envelope point to an uncontained mean would require a distinct v2 $id; that alternative is unnecessary for this bounded criterion.
reader_matrix: old unprofiled v1.1 record -> unchanged new v1.1 decoder/consumer meaning
new profile-bearing v1.1 -> old reader receives a valid explicitly labelled median, exact inline law, and gate_eligible=false; no new mean or law-dependent authority is promised
new profile -> E named-functional reader validates/recomputes profile/carrier and selects the persisted mean
unknown/malformed profile -> named-functional computation refuses rather than falling back to generic point

four_decisions.decision: Choose inline-plus-existing-envelope-CAS-ref. Reuse PosteriorSamplesCarrier for each coordinate, exact shared ordered draw IDs/axes/parameter order/weights and content-bound joint digest; persist the complete carriers/profile through the existing typed envelope writer. Fresh readers resolve the same configured CAS and validate binding before admitted E computation. No second universal law carrier/store/codec or new sampler engine is required.
four_decisions.rationale: The original criterion expressly permits the existing small inline carrier and CAS ref. A sole CAS law ref would add a new resolver contract that these consumers do not need for the bounded finite corpus. The persisted envelope includes the exact law bytes, not summary-only moments.

consumers.boundary: existing fresh typed-ref read -> admitted named mean -> PropagationDispatcher/MonteCarloPropagator, preserving paired empirical rows
existing supported single-coordinate posterior-law path uses admitted named mean; multivariate Welfare without its calibrated-coordinate sampler retains current typed refusal

Actual existing v1.1 adjacent readers/producers are inventoried in the independent source trace and receive an owner-ready compatibility/readback packet. They are not newly appointed by this decision, and E does not attest their consumer changes or acceptance.

four_decisions.lineage: Producer-supplied context binds parameter axis/order, sample_axis, ordered unique shared draw IDs, exact admitted weights, estimand/unit/scale and source/model/fit/rule refs plus applicable time/purpose roles; unavailable provenance remains unknown and non-gating. Thinning/compression is unsupported unless explicitly declared with a restricted computation profile.
four_decisions.refusal: Missing/unresolved exact carrier, forged/mismatched binding or incompatible joint law refuses law-dependent computation before any evaluator/nominal callback. Moments never reconstruct the missing law.
oracles: Same summaries/different atoms remain distinguishable by stored exact carriers and probability queries after fresh read
Paired +1/-1 joint draws remain different after serialize/reopen and yield independently derived difference variances
Permuting all rows together preserves estimands while content/order identity changes; stale digest/individual-coordinate permutation refuses
four_decisions.compatibility_profile: Bounded finite real float64 empirical corpus; unchanged shared MC backend range/failed-support/stopping restrictions. Full production source-law claims still require specific scoped local immutable inputs.
